text.en: DeskPort shares one computer and lets your other devices use its desktop.
text.zh-Hans: DeskPort 把一台电脑共享出来，让你的其他设备使用它的桌面。

text.en: The computer being used is the host; the device you sit at is the client. A computer can be both.
text.zh-Hans: 被使用的电脑是主机，你面前操作的设备是客户端。一台电脑可以同时是两者。

text.en: Devices are bound to each other once. Access is approved on the host and can be withdrawn there.
text.zh-Hans: 设备之间只需绑定一次。访问权限在主机上批准，也可以在主机上收回。

text.en: Open Sharing in the top bar and choose Start sharing.
text.zh-Hans: 点顶栏的共享，选择开始共享。

text.en: Grant screen recording and accessibility access when asked. Sharing runs without them, but the picture or input will not work.
text.zh-Hans: 按提示授予屏幕录制和辅助功能权限。不授予也能启动共享，但画面或输入无法工作。

text.en: A dot under the sharing icon means this computer is currently shared.
text.zh-Hans: 共享图标下面有圆点，表示这台电脑正在被共享。

text.en: Devices on the same network appear on the device list by themselves.
text.zh-Hans: 同一网络里的设备会自己出现在设备列表上。

text.en: Use Add device on the add card for a computer on another network, and enter its address.
text.zh-Hans: 不同网络的电脑，用添加卡片上的添加设备，输入它的地址。

text.en: Selecting a device the first time asks the host for access; approve the request there.
text.zh-Hans: 第一次选择某台设备时会向主机申请访问，在主机上批准即可。

text.en: If another device is already connected, you are asked whether to take over. Taking over disconnects that device.
text.zh-Hans: 如果已经有其他设备在连接，会询问是否接管。接管会断开那台设备。

text.en: Edit in the top bar starts edit mode; drag cards to reorder them.
text.zh-Hans: 顶栏的编辑进入编辑模式，拖动卡片可以排序。

text.en: Drop one device onto another to group them, like folders on a phone home screen.
text.zh-Hans: 把一台设备拖到另一台上就会成组，和手机桌面的文件夹一样。

text.en: Set alias in the card's menu renames a device for this device only.
text.zh-Hans: 卡片菜单里的自定义名称只在本机生效。

text.en: Refresh checks saved devices again and looks for new ones.
text.zh-Hans: 刷新会重新检查已保存的设备，并探测新设备。

text.en: Full screen in the device's settings decides how a connection to that device opens.
text.zh-Hans: 设备设置里的全屏，决定连接这台设备时以什么方式打开。

text.en: Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X switches full screen on and off during a connection.
text.zh-Hans: 连接过程中按 Ctrl+Alt+Shift+X 可以切换全屏。

text.en: On phones and tablets full screen also hides the bottom bar, so the remote desktop gets the whole screen.
text.zh-Hans: 手机和平板上，全屏还会隐藏底部按键栏，远程桌面占满整个屏幕。

text.en: The host can ask a connected device to leave full screen; it never forces it into full screen.
text.zh-Hans: 主机可以请求已连接的设备退出全屏，但不会强制它进入全屏。

text.en: The remote desktop follows your window size, so resizing the window resizes the remote desktop.
text.zh-Hans: 远程桌面跟随你的窗口大小，改变窗口尺寸就会调整远程桌面。

text.en: Virtual screen decides what happens to the host's own screens while you are connected.
text.zh-Hans: 虚拟屏决定连接期间主机自己的屏幕如何处理。

text.en: Desktop fine tuning makes everything on the remote desktop larger or smaller.
text.zh-Hans: 桌面微调让远程桌面上的内容整体变大或变小。

text.en: These settings are saved per device.
text.zh-Hans: 这些设置按设备分别保存。

text.en: A device shown as offline is usually asleep, on another network, or not sharing.
text.zh-Hans: 显示离线的设备，通常是睡眠了、在另一个网络，或者没有开启共享。

text.en: Refresh in the top bar re-checks every saved device.
text.zh-Hans: 顶栏的刷新会重新检查每一台已保存的设备。

text.en: Report a problem in Settings collects a log archive you can attach to an issue. Review it before sharing it.
text.zh-Hans: 设置里的报告问题会生成日志压缩包，可以附在 issue 上。发出前请先检查内容。
